_readme: Placeholder data for Constellation (v3 — 21 countries, 35 fellows). Every name, funFact, and photoUrl below is a fictional placeholder — swap in real fellow details before launch. lat/lng are country capitals so same-country fellows cluster together; per-fellow jitter is applied client-side.
